HOW IT WORKS

Inside the vault

1

Launched on a curve

Every Pons token starts life on a bonding curve. There is no pool and no listing yet — the curve itself is the market, and its price rises as more ETH moves in.

2

Trade before graduation

VaultX reads each curve live and sends your swap straight into it. You buy and sell at the curve's own constant-product price, long before the token ever reaches Uniswap.

3

Graduation unlocks the pool

When a curve's real reserve reaches 4.2 ETH, it graduates: curve trading closes and the token's liquidity moves into a locked Uniswap v4 pool, out in the open for everyone.

Fees, plainly: the curve charges a 3.8% trading fee on each swap, split between the token's creator and the protocol. VaultX adds nothing on top — your transaction goes directly to the curve contract, and the estimate you see already follows the curve's pricing.

VAULTX DOCS

How VaultX works

VaultX is a live board and trading front-end for Pons bonding-curve tokens on Robinhood Chain. Every token shown is read live from the Pons V2 factory on-chain — nothing is hand-listed, and no numbers are cached from anywhere else.

THE CURVE

How the curve works

Each Pons token trades against its own bonding curve instead of a liquidity pool. The curve prices the token with constant-product math: buying pushes the price up along the curve, selling pushes it back down. The quote you see before confirming is computed from the curve's live reserves, so it is the price the curve itself will use.

FEES

What a trade costs

Curve fee3.8% of the input amount
VaultX feeNone — VaultX adds nothing

The curve's 3.8% fee is taken from the amount you put in and is already reflected in the quote and the minimum-received figure before you confirm. Your transaction goes directly to the token's curve contract from your wallet; VaultX never takes custody of funds.

GRADUATION

Graduating to the open market

Graduation threshold4.2 ETH real reserve

While a token is on the curve, it trades only against that curve. When the curve's real ETH reserve reaches 4.2 ETH, the token graduates: curve trading closes and its market moves out into the open. From then on, the token's page here links out to DexScreener instead of offering curve trades.

TRADING

How to buy

  1. Connect a wallet on Robinhood Chain.
  2. Pick a token — from the board, or with the picker in Swap.
  3. Enter the ETH amount and review the quote, the minimum received and your slippage setting.
  4. Confirm the transaction in your wallet. The buy settles directly against the curve.

How to sell

  1. Open the token, switch to Sell, and enter an amount or a percentage of your balance.
  2. The first sell needs a one-time token approval so the curve can spend your tokens — confirm it in your wallet.
  3. Review the ETH quote and the minimum received, then confirm the sell in your wallet.
DATA

Data & reliability

Prices, reserves, balances and volumes are read live from Robinhood Chain through several RPC endpoints with automatic failover. If a refresh fails, the board keeps showing the last successful read, marked as stale, and keeps retrying on its own — it never blanks out.

RISKS

Read this before trading

Bonding-curve tokens are highly volatile, thinly traded and can go to zero. Most new launches fail. Only trade what you can afford to lose, and verify the contract address yourself before confirming anything. Nothing on this page is financial advice.

What is VaultX

VaultX is a live discovery and trading front-end for bonding-curve tokens on Robinhood Chain. Every token launched on Pons appears on one live board — price, market cap, 24h volume, ETH reserve and curve progress — read directly from the chain, with nothing hand-listed and nothing cached from anywhere else. From that board you can buy and sell tokens on the curve, before they graduate, at the curve's own live price. Every curve token, behind one door.

What VaultX does

1

Live board

Every Pons launch on one board — sortable by market cap, volume and curve progress, and searchable by name, ticker or contract address. Data is read live from the chain through several RPC endpoints with automatic failover, so one endpoint going down never blanks the board.

2

Trade the curve

Buy and sell pre-graduation tokens from the token page or the Swap page. Your swap settles directly against the token's curve contract at its constant-product price, the curve's fee is shown before you confirm, and VaultX adds no markup of its own.

3

Graduation tracking

Every token shows its curve progress toward the 4.2 ETH real-reserve threshold. When a curve fills, the token graduates to the open market — and its page here links straight out to it.
